text:
Situation: Phenylephrine hydrochloride 10 mg/mL 1 mL SDV inventory is limited. Corvale East holds 64 vials at 5.9 vials per day, yielding 10.8 days of supply. Corvale General holds 125 vials at the same daily use, yielding 21.3 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include phenylephrine hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21. No public FDA shortage signal exists for this product at our plants.

Our position: Current stock covers approximately 11 to 21 days depending on site. Alternative manufacturers are available and none appear on FDA's shortage list today. Inspection histories vary: Caplin Steriles Limited NAI 2024-08-09; Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC VAI 2024-09-11; Nanjing King-Friend Biochemical Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. VAI 2023-11-10; HAINAN POLY and SANDOZ inspection details not provided.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. (Caplin Steriles Limited, NAI 2024-08-09) — requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC (VAI 2024-09-11) — requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. (Nanjing King-Friend, VAI 2023-11-10) — requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Method Pharmaceuticals, LLC (HAINAN POLY) — requires buyer approval.
5. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Sandoz Inc. (SANDOZ) — requires buyer approval.
6. Pharmacy director to monitor daily usage and adjust par levels — requires pharmacy director approval.
7. P&T committee to review therapeutic alternatives if supply cannot be secured — requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol modifications at this time; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
